rehabilitation ethics educators should consider the following when designing ethics teaching and evaluation: (1) include opportunities for students to reflect on their self knowledge and critical thought processes; (2) include foundational theoretical/philosphical approaches to ethics; (3) ground the teaching in concrete examples and cases drawn specifically from rehabilitation practice; (4) use a wide range of teaching and evaluation methods; and (5) consider the value of creating opportunities for open discussion and self evaluation.
